headline: Why won't he commit to me?
note:
FRAME: commitment. A real man exists. No timeframe, and the read never predicts what he does next — the shadow shape does neither by construction: beat 5 concludes about HER, not about him.

⛔ The block is never a person (authorship ban) — no other woman, no ex, no family.

Allowed by the directional rule: 'he will commit'. Banned: 'he never will', any ruling on his capacity. This read says neither.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE ANYWHERE IN THIS READ. The six beats never need it (open thread, shadow-split-test-checklist.md), and naming an inheritance on a lander is the shortest path to the authorship ban. 'Passed down your family line' is the paid chat's sentence, not the lander's.

⚠ She asks WHY. The shadow method answers sideways: not his reason (a card cannot see inside him, and the interior ban stands), but that the reason is not her.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing told them apart, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand — all of it out.
You asked why he won't commit to you. I can't read his reasons — but nothing on that table is held back.
And yet nothing has been settled. And you've started to think the reason is you.
Something stands in between, close in and not far off. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and yours was held by one rope.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and nothing else on him.
You asked why he won't commit to you. It's the hold itself I'm reading, not his reasons.
Still, nothing has been settled. And the question has turned back on you.
The hold is quiet — it doesn't pull, and it doesn't move. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what this is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed through the backs, and you chose the one already on the move.
Look at his feet. One is up, and the other is coming after it.
You asked why he won't commit to you. The step here is already in motion.
But nothing has been settled. And you're the one asking why.
Something turns up right at the point it would settle. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
